title: Thick cylinder (Lamé)
sentence: A thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure, modelled as a plane-strain quarter section.
theory: Lamé's solution for a cylinder of bore $a$ and outside $b$ under internal pressure $p$ is $\sigma_{rr}(r) = \dfrac{a^2 p}{b^2 - a^2}\left(1 - \dfrac{b^2}{r^2}\right)$ and $\sigma_{\theta\theta}(r) = \dfrac{a^2 p}{b^2 - a^2}\left(1 + \dfrac{b^2}{r^2}\right)$; at the bore $\sigma_{rr} = -p$ exactly, which is the boundary condition the solve has to reproduce.
